insights.title: Potential Misinformation in Grain Supply Report
insights.description: The single verified block from the UN Food Agency report contains an irrelevant and potentially erroneous statement about eating causing weight issues, which does not align with the expected content of a global grain supply report. This suggests possible data corruption, mislabeling, or tampering. The root cause may be a flawed extraction process or intentional misinformation. If unaddressed, reliance on this report could lead to poor decision-making in food policy or market analysis.
insights.root_cause: Data integrity failure: the content does not match the source's expected domain (grain supply vs. general health advice).
insights.forward_implication: Continued use of this source without verification could propagate false information, undermining trust in the system and leading to misguided actions.

insights.excluded_reason: cb_002 — Block is marked as noise (is_noise=true), indicating it contains irrelevant or meaningless content.
insights.agent_reasoning: Single anomalous block from UN Food Agency report contains irrelevant health advice, indicating data integrity issue requiring immediate attention.

action_plan.title: Flag and Quarantine Corrupted Grain Supply Report
action_plan.description: Immediately alert the data integrity team and food policy stakeholders that the UN Food Agency report (cb_001) contains anomalous content unrelated to grain supply. Quarantine the report from any decision-making pipelines to prevent propagation of misinformation.
action_plan.stakeholder: Data Integrity Team, Food Policy Analysts
action_plan.metric_before: Corrupted report active in system, potentially influencing decisions
action_plan.expected_outcome: Report quarantined, stakeholders alerted, no further use of corrupted data

fallback.title: Manual Review of Report
fallback.description: If automated alert fails, manually review the report and escalate to senior data officer.

action_plan.title: Investigate Root Cause of Data Corruption
action_plan.description: Trigger a deep-dive analysis into the extraction and ingestion pipeline for the UN Food Agency report to identify whether the corruption was due to a technical flaw (e.g., mislabeling, parser error) or intentional tampering. Examine logs and source metadata.
action_plan.metric_before: Unknown root cause; potential ongoing data integrity issues
action_plan.expected_outcome: Root cause identified (e.g., parser bug, misrouted data) and documented for remediation

constraints.resource_required: Data engineer, access to pipeline logs

fallback.title: Manual Log Review
fallback.description: If automated analysis fails, manually review extraction logs and source metadata.

action_plan.title: Implement Temporary Validation Rule for UN Reports
action_plan.description: Add a temporary validation rule in the data ingestion system that checks incoming UN Food Agency reports for domain-relevant keywords (e.g., 'grain', 'supply', 'wheat', 'rice') and flags any report lacking them for manual review before integration.
action_plan.metric_before: No validation; corrupted reports pass through automatically
action_plan.expected_outcome: All future UN reports are validated; anomalous ones are quarantined for review

fallback.title: Manual Pre-Approval of UN Reports
fallback.description: If automated rule fails, require manual approval for all UN reports before ingestion.

action_plan.title: Publish Data Integrity Incident Report and Advisory
action_plan.description: Publish an internal incident report detailing the corrupted report, the root cause (once known), and the actions taken. Include an advisory for stakeholders to verify any decisions made using the affected report and to rely on alternative grain supply sources until the pipeline is restored.
action_plan.stakeholder: All data consumers, Food Policy Team
action_plan.metric_before: Stakeholders unaware of data integrity issue; may have used corrupted data
action_plan.expected_outcome: Stakeholders informed, corrective actions taken, trust restored through transparency

fallback.title: Email Alert to Stakeholders
fallback.description: If portal is unavailable, send email alert with same content.

action_plan.title: Monitor Incoming UN Reports for Recurrence
action_plan.description: Set up a monitoring dashboard that tracks all incoming UN Food Agency reports for domain consistency, flagging any that deviate from expected content. Monitor for 30 days to ensure the validation rule is effective and no further corruption occurs.
action_plan.metric_before: No monitoring; corruption could recur undetected
action_plan.expected_outcome: Continuous monitoring in place; any anomaly triggers immediate alert

fallback.title: Weekly Manual Review of UN Reports
fallback.description: If automated monitoring fails, assign a data analyst to manually review all UN reports weekly.
